regression_risks: typography.spec.ts:96-101: turnTimes no longer waits 250 ms after the last turn. It returns as soon as the 'turned' count goes up, and keepStart/where run straight after. If the host posts 'turned' before lastLocation and renderer.page settle, those reads could see an intermediate state. That would fail loudly, not pass silently, and I did not check the host's posting order.

typography.spec.ts:100: if a requested turn ever posts no 'turned' message (for example at the end of the book), expect.poll now times out and the test fails. The old fixed sleep would have passed. Callers start at fraction 0.2 and turn 2-3 times, so this is unlikely.

GlobalSearch.inSmartCollection.test.tsx:124-132: the hard-coded path string duplicates IMAGE_QUERY_AVAILABLE_PATH. If that path is renamed, the filter stops excluding it and the 'sends nothing' cases would fail loudly on the first case to open the window. They would not pass silently.
test_coverage: justified-hold-desktop.spec.ts:278: the positive control now uses a Playwright locator click, which scrolls the element into view, waits for it to be stable and checks the hit target. It still asserts select:<shownKey>, so it shows that the harness records clicks. The held-cell half of the test (lines 263-272) is unchanged and still uses a click at the measured centre.
typography.spec.ts:96-101: each turn now waits for its own 'turned' message. Before, a dropped turn could leave the page on fewer turns than asked, so the wait is stricter, not looser.

sidebarNameInUse.test.tsx:266 and 430-432: settle() was replaced by waits that positively assert the non-409 feedback (toast.error was called; the 'Failed to rename Smart Collection' text appears). toast mocks are cleared in beforeEach (lines 101-107), so the wait cannot pass on a call left over from an earlier test. These waits add assertions.
sidebarNameInUse.test.tsx:358-362: openDialog now also requires focus on the dialog input. Every caller then uses the input, so this only tightens the precondition.

FileDetailFullScreen.smartCollection.test.tsx:164: endCurrentFile now waits for window.__collectionOnEnded to be registered. The 'nothing follows' cases (lines 304, 315, 329) assert empty navigations. Before, they could pass vacuously if onEnded ran before the handler was registered. Now they cannot. The handler is mounted whenever a queue exists (CollectionPanel.tsx:223, 359), including for a file that is not in the queue.

FileDetailFullScreen.inboxNav.test.tsx:164-166: renderAt waits for useFileNav to be called with drive 'main'. useFileNavMock is cleared in beforeEach, and line 223 still asserts the drive explicitly, so nothing is loosened.
FileActions.test.tsx:910-913 and inboxActions.test.tsx:326: synchronous assertions became waitFor/findBy with the same expectations. A missing state still times out and fails.

GlobalSearch.inSmartCollection.test.tsx:124-132: windowRequests() now leaves out /api/addons/intelligence/search/by-image/available. askImageAvailability (imageQuery.ts:115-134) caches the result per drive in a module-level Map, regardless of the query text. Typing or resolving an in: query therefore cannot cause the request, and the exclusion hides nothing the two 'sends nothing' assertions (lines 268, 283) are meant to catch.
